propositions: During a single outbound reconcile pass, effective config resolution via config.effective_* is invoked N times (once per ticket) instead of M times (once per distinct project), causing redundant filesystem stat-walks and overlay resolution across duplicate projects.

The _effective_*_for helpers each independently call the full config discovery pipeline (mapping_config.load_mapping_config → read_reserved_section → _discover_project_config) for identical (project_key, root) pairs within a single pass.
A pass-scoped memoization dict keyed on (axis, project_key) will reduce config resolution from O(N) to O(M) within a single compute_outbound_mutations invocation.
The cache is local to compute_outbound_mutations and threaded as a kwarg to consumers, ensuring pass-scoped lifecycle and no cross-pass staleness without process-global state.
Emitted mutations remain identical per-project because the cache is keyed on both axis and project_key, preventing cross-project leakage and preserving correctness.
